question: Which project should I inspect first?
lead: That depends on the discipline you seek to evaluate. Nhovem engineers real-time interactive canvas engines, distributed enterprise systems, and client-side hardened vaults.

inquiries.label: Show me real-time interactive canvas gameplay
inquiries.response: Inspect Arcane Typer. A fast-paced HTML5 Canvas typing engine built entirely solo, featuring 60 FPS rendering, custom keystroke telemetry, and an in-page live simulation arena.

inquiries.label: Show me large-scale enterprise system design
inquiries.response: Inspect BITS. A production biometric attendance system built over six months with a team of eight. Nhovem built the overtime processing engine, biometric check-in flow, and multi-shift normalization layers.

inquiries.label: Show me security & offline vault architecture
inquiries.response: Inspect Mimic. A cross-platform party game engineered around an isolated, client-side AES-256 encrypted game vault with zero telemetry.
